sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

Thank you for your offer; we are ready to make a firm, longer-term volume commitment to support your capacity planning.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 27.38, volume_per_year 23400, contract_months 24, lead_time_days 56). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We note your volume commitment of 23,400 units over 24 months. 

We can revise our offer to €31.90 per unit to reflect the increased volume and extended contract duration. Our Angebot stands at a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
